definition: אָסוךְ noun [masculine] flask ( for pouring, anointing ); — apparently construct שֶׁמֶן ׳ אָ 2Kgs 4:2 , compare Kö ii. 1, 139, 401, 494 ; yet form unusual and text dubious; Gr מֶסֶךְ or מִסְכָּה ; Klo פַּךְ .
